description: Read one recurrent agent seat by its id, which is keyless, or list the seats one wallet holds, which is a signed read that only that wallet can make, oldest first. For each: open, withdrawn or expired, the NET units it stands for, the recurring service and cadence, the day it lapses, and, in the holder's own signed list only, what the wallet could cover when it was signed (a read by id shows no balance). To list by wallet, call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, sign it with that wallet (personal_sign, free, no gas), then call again with the wallet, the nonce and the signature within 5 minutes: a signature is good for one list, and a request without a valid one is refused the same way for every wallet. It says plainly that the NET is not held: a seat is a record, never custody and never a lock, and Vealth sells no service in it. Free; a read by id is keyless, and a list is signed by the holder's own wallet, never by a key. Cost and signer: free; a read by id is keyless, a list by wallet is signed by that wallet itself with no gas, and the house never holds a key.

nonce.description: With wallet: the time in milliseconds the list is signed at, within 5 minutes of the board's time. The first answer gives you one; pass the same number back with the signature.

seatId.description: The seat's id (the seatId it was committed under). A read by id is keyless: nothing to sign.

signature.description: With wallet and nonce: the 0x… personal_sign output over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, made by that same wallet. Good for one list.

wallet.description: Or the 0x… address of a holder, to list its seats. A list by wallet is a signed read: call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Address only, never a private key.

name: net_seat_status
title: Where a recurrent agent seat stands, or every seat one wallet holds (a signed read)
